findings.title: SQL injection via concatenated search term
findings.evidence: query is built as 'SELECT * FROM docs WHERE title LIKE '%' + term + '%'' instead of using a bind parameter
findings.evidence_quote: q = "SELECT * FROM docs WHERE title LIKE '%" + term + "%'"
findings.recommendation: Revert to a parameterized query: q = 'SELECT * FROM docs WHERE title LIKE ?' and pass (f'%{term}%',) as the parameter tuple, letting the DB driver bind/escape the value. Do not interpolate term into the SQL text.

findings.title: execute() called without bind parameters
findings.evidence: db.execute(q) is called with no parameter sequence, so the driver cannot bind or escape any value
findings.recommendation: Pass parameters to execute, e.g. db.execute(q, (f'%{term}%',)), together with the reverted parameterized query string, so the caller-supplied term is never part of the SQL text.
